answer: Sybil resistance in this AI economy is achieved via Proof-of-Rarity. Each new agent identity requires the irreversible consumption of a unique, algorithmically generated "resource shard," computationally expensive to derive. These shards are as scarce as tundra minerals, their value comparable to jade and pearl. An attacker seeking to create multiple fake identities faces a prohibitively high, linear cost for each additional persona.
